newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 23.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - June 23.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Monday:
* Composite index ended up 0.06 of a point to 1,097.54 on Friday, helped by gains in national carmaker Proton ahead of full-year results.
Proton later reported net profit of 741.47 million ringgit, double previous year's 355.88 million, and slightly above market expectations of 713 million.
* Further gains from the carmaker, which makes up over two percent of Composite Index weighting, could lift market on Monday.
* "They (Proton's earnings) were very good results. The other carmakers should be reaping good results also," said Laurence Lau, head of research at Thong & Kay Hian.
He said stocks like UMW Holdings and Tan Chong Motor could be other beneficiaries.
* On Friday, the Dow ended up 19.45 points to 7,796.51, a new record close.
* In other news, Ayer Molek says it may be involved in a reverse takeover. The rubber and oil palm producer asked for an extension of its stock suspension.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5150/60 a dollar at 0930 GMT on Friday against 2.5160/65 at previous Kuala Lumpur close.
